name: camayoc_ex_my_plate
description: What is on a principal's plate: open work items aegis:assignedTo them.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?item ?label WHERE { ?item a aegis:WorkItem ; aegis:assignedTo <{assignee}> ; rdfs:label ?label . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item aegis:closedAt ?closed } } ORDER BY ?label
